checks.name: Transactional order lifecycle and concurrency
checks.setup_note: PostgreSQL 16 (Testcontainers; Docker required): server-owned quotes, atomic placement with idempotency and a 20-customer capacity race, injected-failure rollback, legal transitions only, expiry/accept races, stock moves exactly once, secure handover. Fails if any named class did not run.

checks.name: Cash ledger and outbox failure recovery
checks.setup_note: PostgreSQL 16: completion never implies payment, separated cash verification, balanced once-only commission groups, provider outage leaves order/inbox committed with bounded retries and visible dead letters, leased workers and duplicate events deliver once, operator replay of failed events. Fails if any named class did not run.
